name: Kotodama-tsukai no Lily
source:
A cute yet melancholic horror game!
Meet Lily, the only "Kotodama User" ever born in her village, and uncover the secrets of the village and the destiny that surrounds her...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13204]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一款可爱又忧郁的恐怖游戏！
遇见莉莉，村子里唯一出生的“言玉使用者”，揭开村子的秘密和围绕着她的命运……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13204]Novelgame[/url]]
